title: Tile corruption mid-screen
backstory: Random garbage tiles keep appearing in the middle third of the playfield. The game is otherwise playable but the display is clearly wrong.
visible_effect: Three tile cells in the VRAM tile map are stuck at specific values; the corresponding screen tiles show garbage patterns
diagnosis_hint: Corrupted tiles that don't change during gameplay point to stuck bits in the video tile RAM. Use a logic probe to check the data bus pins of the 2114 RAM at location E8/F8 on the Centipede board while the game runs.
